description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

versions.changelog:
## [0.9.0] - 2026-09-03

Production release with comprehensive security audit hardening, memory optimizations, and architecture refactoring.

### Features

• Redesign settings screen with grouped list cards and admin dashboard link
• Automatic Intro and Credits skip detection via native Media Segments API
• Server administrator broadcast message notification service
• Multi-tiered in-memory and ETag caching layer across navigation

### Refactor

• Consolidate disparate user JSON storage into unified atomic JsonUserStore
• Unified DOM element builder helper and date/time formatting utilities

### Bug Fixes

• Enforce decode-time memory caps on profile banner uploads
• Decouple request timeouts to prevent image starvation during slow fetches
• Fix search result state restoration on browser back-button navigation

## [0.8.0] - 2026-08-27

Implements social group watching, synchronized playback, and interactive ranking sessions.

### Features

• Group Watch integration backed by native Jellyfin SyncPlay
• Real-time in-player Group Watch chat panel with clickable watch cards
• Interactive ranking sessions with voting brackets and countdown auto-resolve
• Buffer synchronization across joining group members

## [0.7.0] - 2026-08-25

Adds brand identity assets, boot splash video reveal, and external streaming service directory.

### Features

• Streaming hub directory with service branding marks and external links
• Animated jellyfish boot splash video reveal with smooth view transitions
• Progressive asset preloading pipeline for hero carousels and row thumbnails
• Studio hub pages with custom hero banners and catalog rows

## [0.6.0] - 2026-08-24

Introduces multi-user profiles, avatar selection, and enhanced watchlist management.

### Features

• Avatar presets controller, SVG avatar categories, and sidebar avatar picker
• Remembered-user quick sign-in and public user grid on login screen
• Rebrand Favorites to Watchlist with inline card quick actions
• Account settings screen with password change and session termination

## [0.5.0] - 2026-08-22

Enhances the playback engine with stream quality selection and customizable subtitle rendering.

### Features

• Add pre-playback stream picker and mid-playback quality switcher
• Add audio language selection and track switching
• WebVTT subtitle track selector with real-time stream URL resolution
• Subtitle styling bar with custom font size, text color, and background opacity
• Adaptive transcoding fallback for unsupported browser codecs

## [0.4.0] - 2026-08-20

Full video player implementation with playback session reporting, controls overlay, and sleep timer.

### Features

• Fullscreen HTML5 video player with PlaybackInfo negotiation
• Report playback progress, start, and stop events to Jellyfin server
• Port sleep timer backend service, controller, and in-player modal
• Add pause screen overlay with item metadata and playback indicators
• Full keyboard accessibility and navigation across player controls

## [0.3.0] - 2026-08-18

Adds real-time instant search with debounced queries and smooth navigation state restoration.

### Features

• Render live search screen with instant debounced queries
• Add search endpoint integration with direct API layer
• Preserve query parameters and results on back/forward navigation
• Keyboard navigation support for search result cards

## [0.2.0] - 2026-08-17

Expands media catalog browsing with grid views, coverflow carousels, and rich item details.

### Features

• Render a responsive library grid screen with query parameter routing
• Add detailed item metadata endpoint and detail screen layout
• Add season and episode endpoints with season tabs and episode lists
• Add favorites endpoints and favorite toggle on detail screens
• Implement Harbor-inspired coverflow carousel for library pages

## [0.1.0] - 2026-08-16

Initial vertical slice release of Jellio. Introduces the independent client runtime, persistent application shell, and initial media browsing interface.

### Features

• Patch index.html and serve the embedded frontend bundle
• Add auth/session runtime independent of native ApiClient
• Add direct-fetch API layer for screens to read from
• Render a custom home screen with hero carousel and continue watching
• Add hash-based navigation router and persistent sidebar component
• Wire the sidebar and router into the main shell layout

### Refactor

• Extract a shared item card component with watched/progress badges

### Miscellaneous Tasks

• Scaffold plugin project and configure Net9 Jellyfin integration
